text: These glowing balls are Tide Pearls. Somebody is squeezing the tide into them, a little bit at a time.
Grab all six! Run into them, and jump for the high ones.
They're cold. And they sort of slosh.
That's the sea inside. We need to find out who's making them.
Into the training pool, Rory. The bubbles at the top of the screen are your air.
Hold DIVE to swim down, and JUMP to swim up. The bubble streams give you more air.
Or you could just be a submarine. I am just saying.
That was brilliant. It's so quiet down there.
I stayed dry. I watched. It was very good swimming.
Climb in, Rory! You steer. I do the engine noises.
Push the stick where you want to go. JUMP takes you up, DIVE takes you down. Through all the rings!
Wheee! You are a natural. BOLT, did you see?
I saw. It was adequate.
Whoever is stealing the sea has little diving robots. Our spies call them Drips.
These are my practice ones. Press USE near a Drip and your watch pops it in a bubble!
The practice Drips say: blub.
That's all real Drips say too. It's very hard to interrogate them.
The submarine Narwhal is our base for this mission. It needs its supplies.
Your watch has a tractor beam. GRAB a crate, carry it onto the glowing pad and DROP it.
Three crates! One of them is snacks. For you. Not for me. I run on batteries.
There are pearls all over the harbour. On the boats, on the walls, everywhere.
Climb on the boats and jump between them. Mind the mud, it's sticky!
Eight pearls. And footprints. Little round ones.
Drip prints! They go towards the cave.
The cave is round the point. Two Drips with lanterns are guarding it.
Stay out of their yellow light. Sneak behind the rocks to the cave mouth.
I'm in. There's a pipe going down into the water. It's humming.
A pump! Something is pumping the sea away from here.
Gran says the lighthouse lamp has gone funny. It's flashing pearls instead of light.
The stairs wind round and round inside. Collect the pearls all the way to the top.
From up here I can see the whole cove. And a boat with no lights, going out to sea.
Are they smugglers? Or are they Drips?
Look! Somebody on that boat is flashing a lamp. Long and short flashes.
That's Morse code. Each letter is a pattern of flashes. Use the chart and work out the message!
It says: PUMP ONE FULL. SEND TO FUNDY.
Somebody's sending the sea away. Let's switch off that pump first.
The pump is at the bottom of the flooded part of the cave. Dive in and follow the pearls down.
It is too narrow for me. I will wait here and be brave.
Watch your air. There's a bubble stream halfway down.
Pump off! The water's stopped going down the pipe.
Who switched off my pump?
Who said that?
Captain Undertow. Remember the name, little diver. The tide is turning.
That boat with no lights is getting away! It's full of pearls!
Take the jet-ski. Catch up and bump it three times!
Got it! The Drips jumped overboard. Blub, blub, blub.
And the pearls are going back into the sea. Look, the tide's coming in!
The Drips have hidden pearls on top of the Flowerpot Rocks.
Use the bounce pads to get up there. Hop from rock to rock!
Eight! These pearls are heavy. Full of tide.
We need to put the tide back in the bay. Maybe the old tide mill can help.
The old mill has sluice gates. When the pond fills, the wheel turns and powers the tide gauge.
Open and shut the gates to get the water up to the line in the mill pond.
The wheel's turning! The gauge is waking up.
It says the water is being pumped out of the bay from somewhere on the mudflats.
There they are! Drips, digging holes in the mudflats.
They're planting pumps! Bubble them all before they finish.
Five Drips in bubbles. They are floating away towards the sea. There is no sea.
They'll just float for a while then.
The gauge needs power to track the pumps. The wires got muddled up.
Turn the tiles so the power runs from the mill to the gauge.
It's picked up the big pump. It's on a barge just off the shore road!
And somebody's driving away from the mill with the crank handle!
A Drip in a pickup truck! It's got the crank for the barge pump.
Take the buggy. Three bumps and it'll drop it!
Got the crank! Now let's get that barge.
Barges are just lazy boats.
When the tide comes back it'll need somewhere to go. The old fish weir is knocked over.
Carry the stones back onto the glowing spots with your tractor beam.
Perfect! Now the bay is ready for its tide.
And the barge pump is switched off. Listen!
The locks are like steps for ships. Each chamber fills from the one above.
Open the valves in the right order to fill each chamber in turn.
The ship's floating again! Look at it rise!
The Drips hid pearls on the cargo ship. It's rising in the lock right now!
Jump across onto its deck and climb up the containers.
One of these pearls has a label. PROPERTY OF CAPTAIN UNDERTOW.
She's labelling the sea? That's so rude.
Drips have taken over the lock control house.
Sneak past their searchlights and get to the control desk.
The desk shows valves being opened at night. Draining the lake into barges.
The valves are under the lock gates. That means lasers, probably.
The tunnel under the gates is full of red beams now.
Jump the low ones, wait for the moving ones to pass. You know how.
Valves shut! The lake stays in the lake.
A barge is racing away down the canal!
It's heading for the Pacific! Take my dad's speedboat!
Three bumps. Mind the channel markers.
The barge has stopped. It says sorry. In bubbles.
It's full of pearls! And a map of some islands.
BOLT, fly up over the rainforest and look for more Drips from the air.
Rocket feet: go. Rocket feet: going.
I see toucans. I see monkeys. I see a Drip on a raft going towards the sea. It is very slow.
Following it is easy then. Next stop, the Galápagos!
The baby turtles hatched but the sea is too far away now.
Walk in front of a baby and it'll follow you. Lead all four down to the water. Watch out for the crabs!
They're swimming! Little flippers everywhere!
Some of those marine iguanas are Drips in costumes.
Real iguanas sneeze salt. Drips blow bubbles. Bubble the fake ones!
The costumes were very good. I would like one.
The sea lions have been playing with pearls in the bay. They think they're toys.
Dive in and collect them. The sea lions are friendly. Very friendly.
A sea lion just kissed my helmet.
That is how they say thank you. Or hello. Or I think you are a fish.
The rest of the pearls are up on the old lava fields. It's a scramble.
Jump from rock to rock, and use the steam vents to bounce up high.
That's all of them. And there's a radio mast up here that doesn't belong.
A Drip mast! It needs a code to switch off.
The mast plays a tune before it unlocks. Watch the lights and play it back.
Mast off! Its last message went to a salvage boat in the bay.
My turn! The Drips dropped the parts of a pump on the sea bed.
TORPEDO has a claw. Drive over a part, press USE to grab it, and carry it up to the barge's glowing ring.
I am a salvage submarine now. I have a new job title.
I also have a job title. Mine is BOLT.
Pearls are floating on the waves out past the reef. Surf's the fastest way to them!
Steer the board along the wave and grab the pearls.
You're a natural! Totally shredded it.
I don't know what that means but thank you.
The pearls are on the black lava rocks along the coast. Some of them are still warm.
Bounce on the steam vents to get high. And don't touch the glowing lava!
There's a tunnel in the rock with a pipe going in.
That's an old lava tube. Like a cave the lava made.
Undertow's put lasers in the lava tube. Beams and more beams.
Be careful, Rory. It's hot in there too.
The pipe ends in a machine with a drill. It says DRIP DIGGER on it.
That sounds big.
The green sea turtles are hiding at the reef. They say there's pearls everywhere down there.
Dive in! There are bubble streams on the reef.
The turtles let me swim with them.
They like you. They're good judges of people.
A Drip boat is towing a pearl net along the cliffs! Take my jet-ski!
Watch out for the rocks at the bottom of the cliffs.
Net cut! The pearls are sinking back where they belong.
Enough! Drip Digger, show them what you can do.
My Drip Digger drills through lava rock like butter. Imagine what it does to spies.
When it stomps, a ring of steam rolls out. JUMP over it! Then zap it from behind.
It's popped into a bubble!
Oh, very clever. You've stopped one little pump. My Engine is a hundred times bigger, and you'll never reach it.
Engine? What engine?
I don't know. But I don't like the sound of it.
The outer reef drops off like a cliff. The pearls are all down the wall.
It's deep. Use the bubble streams on the way down.
It goes down and down into the blue.
There's the pipe! In the canyon.
Climb in, Rory. The canyons are twisty. I have excellent turning.
Follow the rings through the coral to the pipe.
Not one scratch on the coral. Not one scratch on me.
The pipe goes into the dark.
It's pitch black in there. TORPEDO has sonar!
Press USE to ping. I will make a noise and the walls will light up for a moment.
Find the five markers the Drips left inside.
The pipe opens out. There's a pump bigger than a house.
We need to block its intake.
Rocks! Big ones. I will carry them. You steer, I strain.
Drop four boulders into the pipe's mouth, on the glowing ring.
Blocked! The water's stopped going down the pipe.
Some Drips are still guarding the pump though.
The Drips are swimming round the pump.
Swim up close and zap them into bubbles. They're slippery underwater.
Six bubbles floating up. It looks like a lemonade.
The pump scared the clownfish out of their anemones. They're lost!
Swim near one and it'll follow you. Lead each one home to its anemone.
Everybody's home. Mum's going to be so pleased.
The Drips have hidden pearls on the junks sailing round the harbour!
Jump aboard as they pass the pier, and hop off when you've got them.
Grandpa says you jump like a harbour cat.
Thank you. I think.
That's the ship. The containers are full of pearls.
Sneak along the deck past the searchlights and find the captain's log.
Got it! The log is in code. Morse code.
There's a radio room on the bridge. Let's listen in.
Undertow is sending a message. Listen to the beeps and match them to the chart.
It says: ALL PEARLS TO MALDIVES. THE ISLANDS ARE READY.
Islands made of pearls? What is she up to?
The biggest container has a lock that plays a tune.
Watch it light up, then play it back.
It's full of machinery. Parts of something huge. Stamped TIDAL ENGINE.
There is the engine. I still do not like the sound of it.
A Drip is signalling from the top of a skyscraper!
BOLT, fly up through the rings between the towers and stop it.
The Drip was flashing a torch. I asked it to stop. It stopped. It said blub.
The cargo ship's launch is escaping with the engine plans!
Chase it through the harbour. Mind the junks!
Plans got! They show islands in the Maldives with pipes going down into the sea.
Good luck, Rory! Come back for the light show!
There are pearls on all the new sandbanks.
Swim or jump between them. Some of the water is deep in the channels!
The sandbanks are full of pipes. They're pumping the lagoon dry from underneath.
The pipes have sluice gates. If we can open the right ones, the water flows back.
Get every lagoon up to its line. Some gates fill two at once!
The lagoon is filling! The fish are coming back in.
The manta rays are gathering at the cleaning station. There's a pump right in the middle.
Dive down and collect the pearls round it. The mantas won't hurt you. They're gentle giants.
A manta ray just flew right over me. It was like a spaceship.
The Drips are hiding in the water villas!
Run along the jetties and bubble them.
They were watching television. It was a programme about the sea. They were taking notes.
All the island pumps are wired to one control box. Turn the tiles to cut the power.
Pumps off! But a seaplane is taking off with Undertow's maps!
It's still on the water! Catch it before it takes off!
Bump its floats three times and it'll have to stop.
It's stopped! The Drip pilot is waving a white flag. A very small one.
And here are the maps. Every pump she has leads to one place. The Bermuda Triangle.
The deck is crawling with Drip guards.
Sneak past the searchlights to the main hatch.
I'm in. It's a huge hall full of pipes.
Lasers everywhere. Undertow doesn't want you in the pump hall.
I would help but I am a submarine and this is a corridor.
Past them! There's a control room on the far side.
This panel sends power to every pump in the world. Cut it!
Pumps off, everywhere! Harbours are filling up all over the world!
You think this is my Engine? This is a pantry. My Engine is where you will never follow.
The compasses are useless and the fog's too thick to see.
Sonar! Ping with USE and follow the markers under the base.
There's her submarine, under the base. It's shaped like a squid.
Meet my Kraken. It's a robot squid, and it's very cross.
Jump the rings, and zap its battery pack when it turns round. Four hits!
My Kraken! Very well. Keep your little harbours. The ocean is mine.
She's diving! The whole base is going under!
In you get, Rory! We are not losing her now.
Follow her submarine down through the sinking base. Stay close, through the rings she leaves behind!
She is gone. Down there. Where it is dark.
We'll find her, TORPEDO. Whatever the Tidal Engine is.
Try the suit! Swim down to the wreck and grab the Tide Pearls.
Your air lasts much longer in the suit. The bubble streams top it up too.
The suit's brilliant. I can breathe for ages!
Show-off.
See the streaks in the water? That's a warm current. The turtles ride it like a road.
Swim into it and let it carry you through the rings. Don't fight it!
Wheee! That was faster than TORPEDO.
It was not. I was being polite.
Drip divers! They're laying a pipe along the sea bed.
Bubble them before they finish it!
They were laying a pipe from the sunken base. It goes a long way.
My turn! In you get.
Careful of the mantas. They're gentle, and very big.
Drive through the rings, round the manta school.
A manta winked at me. I am almost sure of it.
The wreck is dark inside. Ping the sonar and find Undertow's markers.
Her markers all point the same way. West.
Along the pipe.
A Drip sub is following the pipe. Let us follow the Drip sub!
Stay close, through the rings it leaves behind.
It went into the kelp. I do not like kelp. It tickles.
There are pearls all up in the kelp, near the surface.
Swim up through the fronds and collect them.
You swim like an otter! Well, nearly.
The Drips left nets all over the sea bed. The otters get tangled.
My claw can lift them! Bring them to the boat.
Every net gone! Thank you, TORPEDO.
You are welcome. I am a hero.
A Drip sub, heading for the deep water!
Through the kelp? It tickles! Fine. Fine!
It dropped something. A picture of an old ship.
More Drip divers, cutting the kelp to make room for the pipe.
Bubble every one of them.
The kelp will grow back. It grows really fast.
The kelp is so thick you can't see a thing. Use the sonar.
The Drips hid their markers in the thickest part.
The markers point out to sea. Towards the wreck in the picture.
Three pups got lost in all the fuss. Lead them back to their mums.
Swim slowly. They follow you like ducklings.
All home! Look, they're holding hands.
That is the best thing I have ever seen.
The front of the ship still has air in it. Get in through the old cargo door.
Close the outer door, pump the water out, then open the inner one. In that order!
I'm in a room with air in it, at the bottom of the sea. That's so weird.
Undertow's been here. There are pearls on every deck.
The grand staircase is still there. Mind the steps.
Someone's been living here! There's a camp bed and a lamp.
Drip guards in the ballroom. They're guarding something.
The ballroom. Marina used to dance there with her grandfather.
A little cabin, with pictures of the sea all over the walls.
Undertow's pipe runs through the old engine room. The pressure's all wrong.
Turn the valves until every gauge is green. Then the pipe stops pumping.
All green! That pipe's stopped.
Stop one pipe, Agent Rory, and I have a hundred more.
The captain's safe fell through three decks when she sank. It's on the sea bed.
Lift it with my claw and bring it back to the ship.
Inside there's a logbook. It's Marina's.
She kept it all these years.
The ship's moving! She's sliding off the ledge!
Everybody out! Follow the rings and don't stop!
We made it. The Neptune is sleeping again.
Goodbye, old girl.
The pipe comes in here somewhere, but it's too dim to see.
Ping the sonar and find the markers along it.
Found it. It's huge, and it's humming.
The pipe's noise has scared the lanternfish away from their shoal.
Lead them home. They glow, so you can see them.
Listen. The shoal is singing again. Well, clicking.
There's a cold current running down the slope, along the pipe.
Ride it down through the rings!
We're really deep now. My ears feel funny.
You do not have ears in that helmet. Well, you do. But still.
A Drip beacon, flashing a code to someone. Crack it!
It says: Tidal Engine. Mariana. Glass Station ready.
The Mariana Trench. The deepest place in the world.
Headlights on! Through the rings, down the canyon.
I did not hit a single thing. Write that down.
Three pipes meet here. Balance the valves and they'll all stop.
Silence! You did it.
Clever. But the deeper you go, Agent Rory, the darker it gets.
Everything that glows down here is alive. Except the pearls. They glow too!
Find the pearls in the dark. Follow the lights.
You found them all! In the dark! You're good at this.
The jellyfish drift on a current right through the canyon.
Ride it with them. Don't touch the jellies!
Some of them were bigger than a bus!
That's Gerald. He's very gentle.
Drips! They've got lamps on their heads. That's how you'll see them.
Bubbled! That was the most exciting thing that's happened to me in two years.
We need a map of the canyon. Ping and find the survey markers.
Got it. The pipe goes straight down to the hydrothermal vents.
Someone's been flashing a lamp from far below. Every night. The same message.
Read the flashes, Rory.
It says: I think I have made a terrible mistake. Signed: S.
S? Who's S?
My battery's nearly flat. Can you take me to TORPEDO? I'll follow you.
A little probe! I will charge you up. I have plenty of charge.
Charging! Oh, that's lovely. Thank you, TORPEDO.
You can sit in my glovebox. I have never used it.
Pearls are stuck to the chimneys. Collect them, but keep out of the hot water!
Not a single burn. Well done!
Through the worm forest, gently. I do not want to tickle them.
The worms didn't even notice. That's how you drive a sub.
Undertow's pump house runs on vent heat. Reroute the power and switch it off.
The pumps have stopped! The pipe to the Engine is running dry.
A Drip sub is getting away through the chimneys!
Mind the smoke. It's very hot.
Caught its trail. It went towards the glass lights.
The Drips knocked my sensors over. Can you bring them back to the lab?
All three! Now I can watch the vents again.
This is where the vent heat goes into the Engine's pipes. Balance the valves to shut it off.
The chimneys are calm again.
You're getting close, Agent Rory. Too close.
The station's airlock. Outer door, pumps, inner door. Don't mix them up!
I'm in. It smells of coffee and seaweed.
Drip guards all through the labs. Sneak to the top dome.
Oh! A child? In a diving suit? How did you get in here?
I'm Professor Silt. Undertow's watching me. I can only talk with the lamp. Read my flashes.
He says he built the Engine because she told him it would save the sea.
She said the sea was in danger. That we'd keep it safe.
The Engine's plans are locked in her safe. Crack the code.
What? Ice bricks? A space elevator? To Mars?
She never told me. She's not keeping the sea safe. She's taking it away!
The alarms! She knows I've been talking to you. Get me out!
Lasers across the corridor. Get Silt to the moon pool.
We're through. Oh, I haven't run like that in forty years.
Everyone in! Professor, you can sit next to Glim.
Hello, Professor! I'll glow for you.
Out through the moon pool and away through the rings.
Thank you, Agent Rory. Now let's stop her. Together.
There's no surface here, just ice. Breathe at the air holes and bubble streams.
Collect the pearls, and watch your air!
You'd make a great ice diver.
The factory floor. Drip guards everywhere. Get to the control room.
Millions of ice bricks. All the sea she's stolen.
Lasers over the conveyor belts. Jump the beams!
Made it to the freezer controls.
I designed this freezer. Cut the power here, and here, and it stops.
The freezer's off! The bricks will melt back into the sea.
A Drip sub with the last load of bricks! Through the ice tunnels!
It dropped the bricks. The sea gets them back.
The narwhals are trapped behind ice blocks. Lift them out of the way!
They're singing! Can you hear them?
I recorded it. I'm keeping it forever.
The first pressure door. The order matters. Get it wrong and the door won't budge.
Perfect. Only three thousand metres to go.
The Engine pulls a current down the trench wall. Ride it!
So deep. And it's all still alive down here.
It always is.
Every pipe from every ocean joins here. Balance it and the whole network slows down.
Harbours are filling up again all over the world!
Her supply sled crashed on the trench floor. Her new logbook's in it.
It says: the cargo pod goes up the space elevator tomorrow. To Mars.
A space elevator. She really did it.
The Engine's entrance is hidden. Ping and find her markers.
There. A door the size of a church.
The last door. Her code. I think I know how she thinks. Let's try.
It's opening. Good luck, Agent Rory.
Welcome to the Tidal Engine.
The intake valves. Balance them all and the Engine can't drink any more sea.
My intakes! Drips! Stop that child!
That's a lot of Drips. That's all the Drips!
Bubble them all, Rory!
Every last one.
They are very bubbly now.
The heart of the Engine. Cut the power to it. I'll talk you through it.
It's stopping! The Engine is stopping!
Then meet my Kraken. The new one. The bigger one.
It is the Kraken again. It has more arms this time.
Same trick! Jump the rings and zap its battery pack. Five hits this time.
Enough! If I can't have the Engine, I'll take what I've already got.
She's in a cargo pod full of ice bricks, heading for the elevator!
Hold on to something, everybody!
We are too late. She is at the lift.
The elevator goes up through the sea. Follow her as far as you can!
She's out of the water. Going up and up, into the sky.
Goodbye, Agent Rory. Look for me on Mars.
Every system on the rig has a check light. The Drips switched them off.
Find the glowing cells and switch everything back on.
All green. Nice work, Agent.
What does this big red one do?
Please don't touch that.
A Drip boat just took a rocket fuel pod!
Grab a jet-ski. Bump them three times and they'll drop it.
Fuel pod back! And a very wet Drip.
Jet-skis. Always showing off on top of the water.
The supplies for Mars go on the lift pad. Stack the crates on the ring.
Food, water, spare socks. We're ready for a long trip.
There are still Drips hiding all over the deck!
Herd them into the cage. Gently. They wobble.
Six Drips in a cage. They're blowing bubbles at me.
That means they're sorry. I think.
They crossed the wires in launch control. Nothing talks to the rocket.
Turn the tiles to join the power back up.
Launch control is online. Now for the countdown.
The launch code is locked. The Drips changed it.
They left clues in their bubbles. Crack the code!
Three, two, one... lift off!
Wow. Look at it go.
And now, Agent Rory, you have an elevator to catch.
The anchor station's full of Drip guards with searchlights.
Sneak through to the control room. Stay out of the light!
My control room! I missed it so much.
The climber bay is behind a laser fence. Undertow's idea, not mine.
Jump the low beams, and wait for the others.
Through! Is that the climber? It's tiny.
It's cosy.
The climber motors get very hot. The coolant valves are all wrong.
Turn the wheels until every gauge is in the green.
Nice and cool. She'll climb like a rocket now.
The power cells for the climber are up the maintenance tower.
Climb up and grab them all. Don't look down!
I looked down.
I also looked down. I did not like it.
I rigged the top of the ribbon to flash a message. Read it for me?
Watch the flashes. Short and long. Tap in the letters.
RACE. That's from my friend at the dock. Undertow's climber is on its way up!
Her climber has a head start. But mine is faster, if you use the boosts.
Steer round the ribbon. Dodge the space junk and grab the boost cells!
We got here first!
Rory! Rory, can you hear me? I am in the supply rocket. In a box. It is very dark.
The dock's power cells floated away when her ship bumped us.
Jetpack out and bring them back. Mind the solar panels!
Spacewalking is the best thing ever.
Spacewalking is the worst thing ever.
Crates are drifting all over the place. Use the tractor beam.
Pull them into the cargo bay, one at a time.
All tidy! Well, tidy for space.
The dock has air inside, and space outside. The airlock keeps it that way.
Outer door, pump the air in, then the inner door. In that order!
Air! I can hear things again.
Undertow wiped the dock's star charts. We need to plot the course to Mars by hand.
Join the stars to make the pictures. Each one points the way.
Course plotted! Mars, here we come.
Fly the dock's little camera drone through the rings. We need to see her ship.
Gently. There's no brakes in space.
Her ship's full of ice bricks. Hundreds of them.
Enough to fill a sea.
Her ship leaves soon. Sneak aboard through the cargo hold!
Her Drips are guarding it. Stay out of their lights.
I'm in. Hiding behind a crate of frozen sea.
All aboard. Next stop, Mars. My beautiful new ocean is waiting.
The station's cells are on top of the big boulders.
Tiny jumps, Rory. Tiny!
I jumped over a boulder the size of a house.
You're such a show-off.
Take my buggy across Stickney Crater. Drive over the glowing cells.
Slowly! The wheels hardly touch the ground here.
You only left the ground eleven times. That's a record.
The mining bots got scared of Undertow's ship and ran off.
Herd them back into their pen.
They're home. They like you. That's a happy beep.
Her ship knocked out the station's lights. Can you fix the wiring?
Lights on! Thanks, Agent Rory.
From Phobos you can see every star. I'll show you how I find my way.
Join them up. The last one points straight at Mars.
There it is. Big and red.
Home sweet neighbour.
Her ship dropped some ice bricks when it landed. They're floating about.
Stack them on the ring before they drift off into space.
Real sea, frozen into bricks. It's so weird.
It belongs back on Earth. We're taking it home.
Take the big rover for a spin. Drive over the glowing sample spots.
Gently round the rocks. It's a long walk home.
Beautiful driving. The rover's never been happier.
This is our helicopter. The air is so thin that its blades spin really fast.
Fly it through the rings round the crater rim.
It flew! On Mars!
Every time it flies, I cheer. Every single time.
There are rock samples all over the old river delta. Collect them for me.
Big floaty jumps, Rory. Mars gravity is only a third of Earth's.
These rocks were once at the bottom of a river. Isn't that wonderful?
We grow our own food in the greenhouse. The plants need you.
Each bed needs water and light at the right time. Watch them closely!
Tomatoes on Mars! Would you like one?
Through my helmet? Maybe later.
Three of my little rovers got lost chasing Undertow's ship.
Lead them back to the rover garage. They'll follow you.
All home safe. They're charging their batteries. That means they're happy.
One of her Drips dropped a locked map case.
Can you open it? The code is in the pictures.
It's a map of her pipe. It runs up the Valles Marineris to the north pole!
A Drip rover is driving along the rim with a bag of pipe parts!
Chase it in the rover and bump it three times.
Got the parts! And the Drip is sulking.
The pipe's valves are down on the ledges. Jump down carefully.
Mars gravity is your friend. Big floaty jumps!
You jump like a Martian.
She's put lasers along the pipeline to keep people away.
Jump the low beams, and wait for the sweeping ones.
Through the lasers. Now for the valves.
If we slow the pipe down, she'll get less water. Turn the valves!
Every gauge in the green, and nothing bursts.
The pipe's slowed right down. That'll annoy her.
Take the helicopter down the canyon. There's a pump station somewhere.
Through the rings, round the cliffs.
Found it! A pump station, halfway down the cliff.
Drip guards all over the pump station. Sneak in and find her plans.
The plans say the ice is at the north pole. And her dome is next to it.
Clever little agent. But the storm will stop you. My storm.
A Drip yacht is sailing off with a storm fan! Hop in mine.
Bump it three times. The wind is on your side.
Beautiful sailing! You're a natural.
The storm has buried the path beacons. Find them, and we can find our way.
Look for the glow through the dust.
Path's lit! Now nobody gets lost.
Even her Drips got blown away. They're rolling about everywhere.
Round them up. They'll be glad to get out of the wind.
They're blowing dusty bubbles. That's new.
We need a shelter from the wind. Stack the blocks on the ring.
Cosy! Well, cosy for a storm.
The weather station controls her storm fans. Rewire it and switch them off!
The fans are slowing down. The storm's going to blow itself out.
Her Drips are flashing signals to each other through the dust.
Can you read them? Short and long flashes.
SUMMIT. They're heading for the top of Olympus Mons!
The climbing route is marked with cells. Fly up and grab them!
Short bursts on the jetpack. Save some fuel for the top.
You fly like a bird. A bird in a spacesuit.
Her Drips have fenced off the crater at the top. With lasers, of course.
Keep low. The net overhead stops the jetpack.
Through the gate. There's a radio mast in the middle.
Her radio is locked. Crack the code and we can hear her messages.
Ice towers, ready. Dome, full. Engine, running. The tide is turning.
The ice towers are at the north pole!
Rocks keep rolling down onto the path! Clear them with the tractor beam.
Pull them into the crater, away from the path.
Path's clear. Thanks, Rory!
There's a greenhouse up here for climbers. The plants are thirsty.
Water and light, at the right time. There are more beds this time!
Strawberries at the top of a volcano. Best snack ever.
You found my radio. Then meet my Dust Kraken!
Jump its rings, and zap the battery pack on its back. Five hits!
My beautiful Kraken! Very well. Come to the pole, little agent. See what I've made.
We're coming, Undertow.
Each tower has a tracker cell on top. Collect them, and we'll know which towers she's melting.
Jump from tower to tower. Don't slip!
Every tower tracked. Clever you.
Drive the ice rover over the sensor spots. It's very slippery.
Gently on the steering!
I only spun round four times.
Five. I was counting.
The brick yard is full of Drip guards. The melt switch is on the far side.
Sneak through. Stay out of the searchlights!
At the melt switch. It's wired up like a puzzle.
Rewire the switch and the towers stop melting. Carefully!
The melting has stopped! The rest of the sea stays safe in its bricks.
There's a crack in the ice between us and the dome. We'll need a bridge.
Stack the ice bricks on the ring.
A bridge made of frozen sea. Now I've seen everything.
I kept a star chart of the way to her dome. The Drips scrambled it.
Join the stars again. There are four pictures this time.
The dome is just over the ridge. Good luck, Rory. Bring the sea home.
The dome is full of air and water. The airlock is the only way in.
Outer door, then the pump, then the inner door. You know the drill.
In. It's warm, and it smells like the seaside.
She's filled the dome sea with Tide Pearls from all over Earth.
Dive in, Rory. Bring them back.
Swimming on Mars. Nobody's ever done that before.
My turn. My sea. Well, Earth's sea. In you get!
Drive through the rings, down to the Engine.
The first submarine on Mars. Write that down, somebody.
The Engine's valves decide which way the water goes. Turn every one.
Every gauge in the green, and the Engine runs backwards.
What have you done to my Engine?
Turned it round. The sea's going home.
You will not take my sea! Kraken, one last time!
Jump the rings and zap the battery pack. Five hits, Rory!
Stop. Please. I don't want to fight any more.
Then help us send it home.
The Engine is pushing the water up the pipe. Ride the current, and open the gates on the way.
Through every ring, Rory. This is it!
The sea's pouring up into the sky. All of it.
Goodbye, sea. See you at home.
Agent Rory. The sea is going down.
Going down where?
That is the question. Harbours are drying out from Cornwall to Hong Kong. Boats are sitting on the mud.
So this mission is under the water. Rory, meet your new partner!
Hello! I am TORPEDO. I am a submarine. I am yellow. I am very fast.
I am BOLT. I am also very fast. On land.
Land is just the bottom of the sea with the water missing.
You two will get on brilliantly. Training first. Follow the beams of light!
Training complete. The first harbour to dry out was in Cornwall. Porthcarrow. Go and find out why.
Cornwall! They have pasties. I cannot eat pasties. I will watch you eat pasties.
You must be Agent Rory! I'm Morwenna. My gran keeps the lighthouse.
Where's the sea?
That's what everyone's asking. Yesterday the boats were floating. This morning they were sitting on the mud.
I do not like mud. Mud is sea that has given up.
Gran saw lights in the smugglers' cave last night. Little round lights. Blowing bubbles.
Drips! Start in the harbour, Rory.
The tide's coming back in! Look at the boats bob!
The pump was stamped with a maker's mark: a wave, and the letter U. And its logbook says the next stop is the Bay of Fundy, in Canada.
Canada has the biggest tides in the world. Had. Has. I hope has.
Bonjour, Agent Rory! I'm Émile. Welcome to the Bay of Fundy.
Twice a day the tide here goes up higher than a house. Or it did.
Those rocks look like giant flowerpots.
The Flowerpot Rocks. The sea carved them. Now it's gone and they look lonely.
I know how they feel. I have been out of the water for eleven minutes.
Captain Undertow's logbook said Fundy. Let's find her pump.
Here comes the tide! It's racing in. Merci, Rory, merci, TORPEDO!
Undertow's boat got away, heading south. The tide gauge caught its radio: the Panama Canal.
A canal is a river that went to school.
¡Hola, Agent Rory! I'm Valeria. My dad is a canal pilot. He steers the big ships through.
Why is that ship stuck?
The locks are running dry. Every ship between the oceans is stuck.
I will push them. I am small but I am determined.
Undertow is up to something in the lock machinery. Let's get the ships moving.
The ships are moving! Dad says gracias. He's never been so happy to be in a queue.
The barge you caught was carrying pearls to the Galápagos Islands. Out in the Pacific.
The Galápagos have giant tortoises. I would like to race one. I think I would win. Just.
¡Bienvenido, Agent Rory! I'm Mateo. I help look after the giant tortoises.
That tortoise is enormous.
That's Doña Rosa. She's a hundred and twenty years old. And she's worried.
Why is she worried?
The rock pools are drying up and the baby turtles can't reach the sea. And I've seen iguanas that go blub.
Drips in disguise! Let's help the babies first.
The pools are full and the babies made it! Doña Rosa says thank you. Slowly.
The disguised Drips had orders for Hawaii. They're using the volcanoes for something. Hot water, perhaps.
Hot water? I am a submarine, not a teapot.
Aloha, Agent Rory! I'm Kai. I surf, mostly. And I help at the volcano centre.
Is that lava going into the sea?
It's been doing that for thousands of years. It makes new land. But now there's less sea to meet it.
I will stay well away from the lava. I have a yellow paint job to think about.
Undertow's pumps are using the volcano's heat. Let's find them.
The waves are back! Look at those sets rolling in. Mahalo, Rory!
The Drip Digger's memory shows a pipe on the Great Barrier Reef, in Australia. The biggest pump yet.
The reef is alive. It is made of tiny animals. Billions. I cannot count that high. I tried.
G'day, Rory! I'm Ruby. My mum studies the coral here.
The reef's drying out at low tide, and low tide keeps getting lower.
It's beautiful. Look at all the colours.
It's the biggest living thing in the world. And something is sucking the water off it.
This is what I was built for. Coral! Fish! Proper sea!
The Digger pointed at a pipe on the outer reef. Suit up, Rory.
The water's back over the reef! The coral's happy. The fish are happy. I'm happy!
The pipe's records show a whole fleet of cargo ships in Hong Kong. Undertow is shipping pearls somewhere.
Hong Kong at night has the best lights. I will match them.
Agent Rory! I'm Ming. My grandpa sails the last red-sail junk in the harbour.
The lights are amazing.
Every night at eight they do a light show. But tonight the harbour is half empty and the ferries are scraping the bottom.
I will scrape nothing. I am very careful.
Undertow's cargo ships are here. Let's find out where they're going.
The harbour's full again! Grandpa's junk is sailing tonight.
The cargo was going to the Maldives. Islands are popping up there where there was only sea.
New islands. Undertow is making land. I do not approve.
Welcome, Agent Rory! I'm Aisha. My mum flies the seaplanes between the islands.
Those islands look brand new.
They are! They weren't there last week. The sea has gone down so far that sandbanks are poking out.
The lagoon is so shallow. I can feel my tummy on the sand.
Undertow said the islands were ready. Ready for what?
The sandbanks are going back under. That's how it should be!
Enough, Agent Rory. If you want your precious sea, come and get it. I'll be waiting in the Bermuda Triangle.
The Bermuda Triangle. Where ships go missing. Be careful, Rory.
Agent Rory? I'm Nia, Bermuda Coast Guard cadet. The compasses have been spinning for a week.
What is that?
That's Undertow's base. It floats. It's as big as a town.
It is also ugly. I am sorry, but it is.
Welcome aboard, Agent Rory. Do wipe your flippers.
This is it, Rory. Find out what the Tidal Engine is, and stop it.
She's gone. The whole base is sinking after her!
She is going down. Deep. Deeper than I have ever been.
Then that's where we follow. Get some rest, Agent Rory. Tomorrow, we go into the abyss.
End of Act One. Act Two: Into the Abyss is coming soon!
Agent Rory. The Bermuda base has sunk, and Undertow went down with it.
You'll need this. A diving suit, with a fish-bowl helmet and ninety seconds of air!
It's got flippers. I love it.
Finally. You will swim almost as well as me. Almost.
Welcome aboard the Albatross! I'm Dr Lani. I study everything that lives in the sunlit water.
And something strange is going on down there. Come and see.
The pipe runs west, along the sea bed. Towards the coast of California.
Then so do you, Agent Rory. There's a kelp forest in the way.
A forest. Under the sea. This I must see.
Shh! You'll scare the otters. I'm Rosa. I look after them.
Why are they all hiding?
The Drips are cutting paths through the kelp, and putting nets across them.
The kelp is swaying. I feel seasick. Can a submarine be seasick?
The otters are safe, and the pipe goes out to sea. Towards a shipwreck.
Not just any shipwreck, Rory. The RMS Neptune. The biggest liner that ever sank.
Why would Undertow go there?
That's what you're going to find out.
So you're the young agent. I'm Captain Barnaby. I sailed on the Neptune, sixty years ago.
Before she sank?
Long before. There was a girl aboard who loved the sea more than anyone I ever met.
She'd sit on the deck all day, listening to the waves. Her name was Marina Undertow.
Undertow? The Undertow?
The very same. Be careful in there. The old ship creaks.
Her logbook says the pipe goes down. Down into the dark, where the light runs out.
The Twilight Zone. Poor Marina. She always said nobody listened to the sea.
We're listening now. Go on, Agent Rory.
Hello! I'm Dr Hiro, and this is my deep submarine, the Kaiko.
It is very big. Is it friendly?
Very. We're two hundred metres down. The sunlight is almost gone.
It's all blue and dim, like the evening.
That's why it's called the Twilight Zone. And everything here makes its own light.
The pipe goes down a canyon. Into the Midnight Zone, where there's no light at all.
None?
Only what the animals make. Take your helmet lamp.
And TORPEDO's headlights. You're going to need them.
It's pitch black. I can only see what my lamp shows.
And the lights. Look at all the little lights.
Hello! Hello! Are you real? Nobody's been down here for ages!
Me! Glim! POLARIS probe number nine. I got lost two years ago and nobody came to find me.
Probe nine! We thought you were gone forever!
The pipe goes down to the vents. Where the sea floor is on fire. Well, hot.
Glim, you're coming home with us after this.
Really? Hooray! I'll light the way.
Welcome to the vents! I'm Dr Ama. I study the chimneys.
They're puffing black smoke!
Hot water, full of minerals. Hotter than an oven. Don't swim through it!
Giant worms! There are giant red worms!
Tube worms. They're lovely. And Undertow is using the vents' heat to power her Engine.
The heat pipes go north-west, to a station made of glass.
The Glass Station! That's where the flashing comes from!
Then that's where S is. Go carefully, Rory.
A station made of glass domes, on the sea bed.
It is glowing. It is beautiful. It is also full of Drips.
The flashes came from that little dome, at the top.
Get inside, Rory. Find S.
The Engine is at the bottom of the Mariana Trench. I'll take you there myself.
Professor Silt. Welcome to POLARIS.
Thank you. I'm so sorry. I only wanted to help the sea.
You still can.
Before the Engine, the ice factory. Under the Arctic ice. That's where she makes the bricks.
Hi! I'm Nuka. I dive under the ice with my dad. The narwhals are scared of the noise.
Narwhals? The ones with the long tusks?
The unicorns of the sea! The factory has trapped some of them.
It is very cold. My headlights are shivering.
The narwhals are free! Look at them go!
No more bricks. Now there's only the Engine itself.
The Mariana Trench, Agent Rory. This is it.
The deepest place on Earth. Eleven kilometres down.
It's like looking into space.
My hull is creaking. That is normal. Probably.
Undertow's pressure doors are the only way down. I'll help you through them.
The Engine is below us. The biggest machine ever built under the sea.
Come down, then, Agent Rory. Come and see what I've made.
All POLARIS agents, stand by. Rory's going in.
It's enormous. Pipes, pumps and a great glowing heart.
Beautiful, isn't it? Every sea in the world, flowing into my Engine.
Frozen, packed and sent to Mars, where nobody will ever pollute it again.
But people need the sea! The fish, the turtles, the otters. Everybody.
People never listened to the sea. I did.
Marina, please. This isn't the way.
The tide is turning, Agent Rory. Up there, not down here.
She's in the cargo pod! Going up the space elevator!
But the Engine's stopped! Rory, look. The water's flowing back!
Harbours are filling all over the world. Well done, Agent Rory. Well done indeed.
Pip, get me Commander Vega. We're going to Mars.
Commander Vega here. I've been waiting for this call.
End of Act Two. Act Three: Red Planet is coming soon!
Agent Rory. Undertow's cargo pod went up her space elevator last night. Full of frozen sea.
Commander Vega, POLARIS space. Welcome to the Sea-Launch Platform.
My rocket can follow her. But somebody has been messing with it.
Undertow's Drips? Here?
Drips. Dozens of them. They swam over from her elevator.
I am coming too. I do not know how yet. But I am coming.
The rocket's ready. But it can only carry the supplies, not passengers.
Then Rory goes up the elevator! She'll never expect that.
Up a ribbon into space. Easy.
I will hold your hand. It is not because I am scared.
Whoa. It just goes up and up and up.
Thirty-six thousand kilometres of ribbon. I built the climbers that ride it.
I'm Otis. Undertow told me it was for a space hotel. A hotel!
Now her Drips have locked me out of my own station.
Then we'll get you back in.
You beat her climber! Nobody has ever gone up the ribbon that fast.
My ears are still popping.
The top of the elevator is the Orbital Dock. Undertow's Mars ship is waiting there.
Welcome to the top of the world! I'm Juno. I run the dock.
Everything floats up here, so hold on to something.
Hold JUMP to fire your jetpack, Rory. Let go to drift.
I am floating. I did not agree to this.
And that big ugly ship at the end? That's Undertow's. It's loading her ice for Mars.
Her ship's leaving, and you're on it! Good luck, Agent Rory.
I'm right behind you in the supply rocket. With a very grumpy submarine.
I am not grumpy. I am just in a box.
Her ship's stopped at a little moon. It looks like a potato.
Hey! That's my home you're talking about. I'm Tycho. I was born on Phobos.
Be careful. There's hardly any gravity here. Jump too hard and you'll float off.
I am holding on to the ground with all my fingers.
Her ship's gone down to Mars. Your friends just landed next to it.
Jump in, Agent Rory. We're going down to Jezero Crater.
I am out of the box! Mars smells funny.
You can't smell anything, TORPEDO. You're a submarine.
Welcome to Mars, Agent Rory. Mind the first step. It's a big one.
I'm on Mars. I'm actually on Mars!
And I'm Dr Amani. I run the rovers here in Jezero Crater.
This crater was a lake, once. Billions of years ago. Mars had water.
And Undertow wants to give it water again. Ours.
Her map shows a pipe running up the great canyon. The Valles Marineris.
The rover will get you there. Hold on to your helmet.
I have glued mine on.
Hola! I'm Lucía. I guide people through the canyon.
It's four thousand kilometres long. On Earth it would stretch right across America!
And there's a pipe running along the bottom.
It appeared last week. Nobody asked me.
The pipe goes north, into the dust storm. Nobody goes into the storm.
Except Agent Rory.
Then take my friend Sol. He races sand yachts through storms for fun.
G'day! I'm Sol. Welcome to the biggest dust storm on Mars!
I can't see a thing.
That's the fun part. My sand yacht sails on the wind.
Undertow is making this storm, Rory. With giant fans. To hide her dome.
The storm's dying down! Look, you can see the sun.
And a mountain. A really, really big mountain.
Olympus Mons. The biggest volcano in the solar system. Her radio is on top.
Hi! I'm Hana. I'm climbing to the top. It's twenty-two kilometres high!
That's two and a half Mount Everests.
So I brought a jetpack. And one for you!
Hold JUMP to fly, Rory. The jetpack works here, the air is so thin.
We did it! The top of the tallest volcano in the solar system!
And her radio says the ice is at the north pole. Silt is waiting there.
Race you there!
Rory! Over here! It's Professor Silt. POLARIS flew me up to help.
Professor! What is all this?
The stolen sea. Frozen into bricks and stacked into towers. Miles of them.
She's melting them into her dome, one tower at a time.
We've stopped the melting. But the Engine is in her dome, and the dome is full of sea.
A sea? On Mars? Did somebody say SEA?
TORPEDO's coming with you, Rory. This one's a dive.
It's a sea. A whole sea, under a glass dome. On Mars.
Beautiful, isn't it? A sea nobody can ruin. A sea that is only mine.
It is very nice water. But it is not yours.
The Tidal Engine is at the bottom, Rory. Turn it round, and the sea goes home.
My sea. It's going.
It's going home. Where people need it.
Nobody ever listened to the sea but me.
Then come and work for POLARIS, Captain. We could use someone who listens.
I... would like that.
And on Earth, it's raining! It's raining on every harbour in the world!
All three golden starfish here! TORPEDO is very pleased.
Look for the tall beam of light, Rory. That is where we go next.
The glowing beacon is where the next mission starts.
I am ready when you are. I am always ready. Mostly.
